Kamila Szymanska joined our team as a Senior DevOps Engineer at NexaCorp, bringing a clear focus on reliability and efficiency. Her role quickly evolved beyond traditional DevOps boundaries, as she consistently identified systemic improvements across infrastructure and workflows.  

Kamila’s technical contributions are rooted in her ability to balance automation with adaptability. She spearheaded the migration of CI/CD pipelines to GitHub Actions, reducing deployment latency by 40% while maintaining compliance with security standards. Her expertise in Linux administration ensured seamless scalability during peak loads, and her integration of Prometheus/Grafana for monitoring provided actionable insights that cut incident resolution time by half. Beyond tools, her work on cloud cost optimization introduced granular tagging practices that saved the team over $15K annually.  

Equally notable is her collaborative spirit. She mentored junior engineers through complex PostgreSQL optimizations, fostering a culture of shared problem-solving. Her REST API designs for internal tools streamlined cross-team integrations, eliminating redundant manual processes. Kamila’s proactive approach to SLA/SLO management ensured minimal downtime, earning her recognition during NexaCorp’s quarterly performance reviews.  

Her reliability and curiosity make her a trusted partner. Whether troubleshooting network issues under pressure or refining database queries to boost performance, she approaches challenges with intellectual rigor and humility. I wholeheartedly recommend Kamila for any role requiring technical depth, strategic thinking, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Her impact extends beyond her responsibilities, elevating the entire team’s capabilities.
